# gardience_bootstrap_script (Data Source)

A first-boot script for one machine: its name in Gardience and its own groups on top of the enrollment's. Use `content` as the instance's `user_data`. It contains the enrollment token, so it is marked sensitive.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gardience_bootstrap_script" "web1" {
  enrollment_id = gardience_enrollment.web.id
  os            = "linux"
  node          = "web-1"
  groups        = ["blue"]
}

resource "aws_instance" "web1" {
  ami           = var.ami
  instance_type = "t3.small"
  user_data     = data.gardience_bootstrap_script.web1.content
}

# Windows on AWS: user_data = "<powershell>${data.gardience_bootstrap_script.win1.content}</powershell>"
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enrollment_id` (String) `gardience_enrollment.<name>.id`
- `os` (String) `linux` (POSIX sh) or `windows` (PowerShell).

### Optional

- `groups` (List of String) Extra node groups for this machine.
- `node` (String) The machine's name in Gardience. Default: its host name.

### Read-Only

- `content` (String, Sensitive) The script.
